title: Jazzy Crunchy Peruvian Shio-Koji Causa
description: A comforting Peruvian dish that combines the flavors of shio-koji, crunchy bread, and creamy avocado. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or lunch.

ingredients.name: Double-rise bread
ingredients.notes: crusty on the outside and fluffy on the inside

ingredients.name: Shio-koji
ingredients.notes: Japanese fermented rice vinegar, used to marinate the bread

instructions: Toast the bread until crispy and golden brown.
In a blender or food processor, combine shio-koji, lime juice, and olive oil. Blend until smooth and creamy.
In a large bowl, combine tuna, red onion, hard-boiled egg, avocado, and chopped cilantro. Mix well.
Add the toasted bread to the bowl and toss until the bread is evenly coated with the tuna mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and top with the shio-koji dressing.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
